# VoiceReason.AI

> VoiceReason.AI is phone-based practice for people whose job is mostly conversation. A team member dials a phone number, gives an access code, and practices a real conversation with an AI buyer that uses a synthetic voice. On the Practice + Coach plan, an AI coach comes on the same phone call right after the buyer hangs up and talks the call through. After every call, a written feedback report is emailed to the team member, once they have an email on file.

VoiceReason.AI is made by Pyrigen Incorporated.

## How it works

- No app, no download and no login for the team member. They dial a number and give their access code.
- The buyer is software with a synthetic voice, not a person. So is the coach.
- Practice calls are recorded, and the line says so.
- The written report covers discovery, qualification, how objections were handled, and whether the call ended with a real next step.
- Practice conversations belong to the customer's account and are not used to train models for anyone else.
- There is nothing to integrate and no CRM to connect. The manager issues codes and sends them out.

## Plans (per seat)

- Practice: $69 per seat per month, or $759 per seat per year. 280 minutes a seat each month, up to 45 minutes on one call. Includes a written feedback report emailed after every call, once the team member has an email on file.
- All the seats on a plan share one pool of minutes.
- Practice + Coach: $129 per seat per month. 420 minutes a seat each month, up to 60 minutes on one call. Adds a live AI coach on the line right after every call. Coaching time uses the same minutes.
- One seat is one person who makes practice calls, with one access code. The manager login does not use a seat.
- Customers can cancel at any time. Canceling stops the next charge, and the plan stays active through the period already paid for.
